description: Camera punch-in: smoothly zoom the page toward a target (CSS selector or visible text) — the money shot for a metric, button, or result. Captions stay screen-fixed; the content scales under them. ALWAYS studio_zoom with reset=true before navigating or showing the end card, or the next scene inherits the zoom.

duration_ms.description: Zoom animation length in milliseconds. Optional; default 1100.

reset.description: true eases the camera back to 1:1 (call before navigating or showing the end card, or the next scene inherits the zoom). Ignores target/zoom_scale. Default false.

target.description: CSS selector or visible text to punch in on (centered). Required unless reset=true. Example: '.big-number' or 'Sign up'.

zoom_scale.description: Zoom factor (>1). Optional; default 1.7. Keep ≤2.2 — beyond that the page pixelates. Ignored when reset=true.

name: studio_zoom
